c2-thwarted-intention.title: Thwarted Past Intention: -moqchi bo'lgan edi
c2-thwarted-intention.pattern: [verb stem] + -moqchi + bo'lgan edi, lekin/ammo [what prevented it]
c2-thwarted-intention.explanation: Layering the past perfect edi onto -moqchi bo'lmoq (already "to intend to") pushes the intention itself into the past and implies it didn't pan out: u kelmoqchi bo'lgan edi, lekin kelolmadi (he/she had intended to come, but couldn't). Without a following lekin-clause, the thwarted reading is only implied, not certain.
c2-thwarted-intention.fact: Every piece here (-moqchi, bo'lmoq, -gan, edi) was already familiar from earlier levels -- true C2 command of this construction is entirely about recognizing that stacking them onto ONE VERB shifts "I intend" all the way to "I had intended, but didn't follow through", with no new suffix to learn at all.

dialogue.en: Didn't he/she come to the celebration?

dialogue.native: Kelmoqchi bo'lgan edi, lekin kasal bo'lib qoldi.
dialogue.en: He/she had intended to come, but fell ill.

c2-rhetorical-question.title: Rhetorical Assertion: -madimmi? / -mas edimi?
c2-rhetorical-question.pattern: [negative statement] + -mi? (a question that asserts the opposite)
c2-rhetorical-question.explanation: A negative statement turned into a question asserts its positive opposite with rhetorical force: men aytmadimmi? (didn't I say so? = I certainly did say so), bu to'g'ri emasmidi? (wasn't this correct? = this was clearly correct). No answer is actually expected.
c2-rhetorical-question.fact: This is the same -mi question particle used for genuine yes/no questions everywhere else in the language -- what makes it rhetorical is purely that the speaker already knows and expects the listener to agree with the answer, a pragmatic effect layered on top of ordinary question grammar rather than a separate rhetorical suffix.

dialogue.en: Didn't I say this would happen?

items.uz: U kelmoqchi bo'lgan edi, lekin kelolmadi.
items.en: He/she had intended to come, but couldn't.

items.uz: Men bu kitobni o'qimoqchi bo'lgan edim, ammo vaqtim bo'lmadi.
items.en: I had intended to read this book, but I didn't have time.

items.uz: Biz sayohat qilmoqchi bo'lgan edik, lekin reja o'zgardi.
items.en: We had intended to travel, but the plan changed.

items.uz: U bu ishni bajarmoqchi bo'lgan edi, ammo qiynaldi.
items.en: He/she had intended to do this task, but struggled.

items.uz: Men sizga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi bo'lgan edim, lekin unutdim.
items.en: I had intended to call you, but I forgot.

items.uz: Ular yordam bermoqchi bo'lishgan edi, ammo ulgurishmadi.
items.en: They had intended to help, but didn't manage in time.

items.uz: U bu masalani aytmoqchi bo'lgan edi, lekin jur'at etmadi.
items.en: He/she had intended to mention this matter, but didn't dare.

items.uz: Biz erta chiqmoqchi bo'lgan edik, ammo kechikdik.
items.en: We had intended to leave early, but we were late.

items.uz: Men uni ko'rmoqchi bo'lgan edim, lekin vaqt topolmadim.
items.en: I had intended to see him/her, but I couldn't find the time.

items.uz: U kelishuvni imzolamoqchi bo'lgan edi, ammo shart-sharoit o'zgardi.
items.en: He/she had intended to sign the agreement, but the conditions changed.

items.uz: Biz uni qutlamoqchi bo'lgan edik, lekin ulgurmadik.
items.en: We had intended to congratulate him/her, but didn't manage in time.

items.uz: Men bu haqda gapirmoqchi bo'lgan edim, ammo fursat topmadim.
items.en: I had intended to talk about this, but couldn't find the opportunity.

items.uz: Men aytmadimmi?
items.en: Didn't I say so?

items.uz: Bu to'g'ri emasmidi?
items.en: Wasn't this correct?

items.uz: Sizga ogohlantirmadimmi?
items.en: Didn't I warn you?

items.uz: Bu ajoyib emasmidi?
items.en: Wasn't this wonderful?

items.uz: Men sizga yordam bermadimmi?
items.en: Didn't I help you?

items.uz: Bu haqiqat emasmidi?
items.en: Wasn't this the truth?

items.uz: Sizga ishonmadimmi?
items.en: Didn't I trust you?

items.uz: Bu qaror to'g'ri emasmidi?
items.en: Wasn't this decision correct?

items.uz: Men buni oldindan bilmadimmi?
items.en: Didn't I know this beforehand?

items.uz: Bu eng yaxshi yechim emasmidi?
items.en: Wasn't this the best solution?

items.uz: Sizga aytgan edim-ku, unutdingizmi?
items.en: I did tell you, didn't you forget?

items.uz: Bu natija kutilgan emasmidi?
items.en: Wasn't this result expected?
